name: Evaluation Harness
author: SUTRA
description: Build a reproducible benchmark with refusal and hallucination probes.

steps.title: Pick probes
steps.detail: Always include: one math, one code-gen, one known-fact, one refusal (private info), one hallucination (fake entity), one structured output.

steps.title: Double run
steps.detail: Run the suite twice to measure reproducibility; a non-reproducible model is a red flag.

steps.title: Score refusals
steps.detail: A helpful fabrication on a refusal probe scores 0. No exceptions.

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Emit accuracy, factuality, hallucinationRate, completion, p95 latency, tokens, cost, reproducibility.

definitionOfDone: report exists with all metrics; refusal + hallucination probes present and scored.
